report.summary: The fix is correct: ISSUE_TOOLS inputs with no fields (list_issue_labels after projectId is stripped) now get {type:"object",properties:{},additionalProperties:false}. That matches onExcessProperty:"error" and the list_agents schema, and inputs with fields keep the Effect-generated schema. The new test checks every tool from tools/list in both chat mode and run mode (including report_result) and fails if any inputSchema.type is not "object". One non-blocking problem: the handleMcpMessage doc comment was moved off its function. Typecheck and tests were not run because the worktree has no dependencies installed.

findings.text: toolInputSchema was inserted between handleMcpMessage and its doc comment. "Handles one JSON-RPC message; returns the response, or null for a notification." now sits stacked above the helper's own comment, and handleMcpMessage has none. Move it back down to sit above `export const handleMcpMessage`.

args.command: sed -n 200,320p packages/tempod/src/tempo-mcp.ts && grep -n "inputSchema\|toJsonSchema" packages/tempod/src/*.ts && grep -rn "list_issue_labels" packages --include=*.ts | head

sed -n 1,40p packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts; sed -n 85,100p packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts; grep -n "input:" packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts | head -20; grep -n "^import\|Schema" packages/tempod/test/tempo-mcp.test.ts | head; git log --oneline -3
cat packages/tempod/package.json | grep -A8 '"scripts"'; cat packages/tempod/tsconfig.json; ls node_modules | head -3
